# launch-guard

> launch-guard checks a private git repository (or the npm package you are about to publish) before you make it public: secrets, personal details, restricted terms and old commits that stay reachable. It never prints what it finds, so it is safe to run under an AI assistant. MIT licence, by Voyageur Works.

Run it (Node.js 22 or newer): `npx -y @voyageurworks/launch-guard-pack path/to/repo --offline`
Exit code 0 means nothing blocks publishing; 1 means something does.
